configureAttributes.heading: Attributes
configureAttributes.emptyDescription: Attributes are declared per workflow. Create one to get started.

requestSummary.noSchemaDeclared: No schema declared for this request.

configureLists.heading: Lists
configureLists.label: Label
configureLists.deleteFieldConfirmBody: Existing rows and any workflow already using "{{key}}" keep their data. New match parameters just won't offer it, and its key can't come back with a different type.
configureLists.addColumnFirst: Add at least one column, then Save, to start adding rows.
configureLists.emptyDescription: A reusable typed dataset a workflow's List Search (or List Lookup) step can resolve against.

import.mappingHeading: Match each file column to a list column

profileCaption.login: Sources the shell's login startup files (.zprofile / .bash_profile) in addition to the variables below. Matches your terminal, but less deterministic.

configureExecEnv.heading: Execution Environments
configureExecEnv.label: Label
configureExecEnv.workingDirectoryCaption: Use {{sentinel}} to mint a fresh, Mill-owned temp directory for each run, or a real absolute path.
configureExecEnv.environmentVariablesCaption: Explicit only. Leave empty for a minimal default PATH.
configureExecEnv.emptyDescription: A reusable, pinned shell/directory/env a code-execution workflow step can run inside.

configureDecisions.heading: Decisions
configureDecisions.pageDescription: A Decision is a reusable, typed terminal outcome that a workflow's Decision step reaches to end the run with a real category and typed result, instead of just running out of steps.
configureDecisions.label: Label
configureDecisions.categoryCaptionEditing: Fixed once created; duplicate this Decision to use a different category.
configureDecisions.categoryCaptionCreating: Fixed once created; duplicate this Decision later to use a different category.
configureDecisions.outputsDescription: This Decision's typed result fields, bound by a workflow's decision-outcome step when it reaches this outcome.
configureDecisions.deleteFieldConfirmBody: Existing runs and any workflow already bound to "{{key}}" keep working. New bindings just won't offer it, and its key can't come back with a different type.
configureDecisions.webhookDescription: Fires this request with the outcome's outputs as its body when this Decision is reached. External calls ask for approval by default, like any Integration step.
configureDecisions.emptyDescription: A reusable, typed TERMINAL outcome a workflow's Decision step reaches to end the run.

configureMCPServers.heading: MCP Servers
configureMCPServers.label: Label
configureMCPServers.commandCaption: Run over stdio, e.g. a locally installed MCP server binary.
configureMCPServers.emptyDescription: A reusable stdio connection an mcp-tool-call workflow step can resolve by ID.

configureAIProviders.heading: AI Providers
configureAIProviders.label: Label
configureAIProviders.baseUrlCaptionAnthropic: Leave empty to use the real Anthropic API (api.anthropic.com).
configureAIProviders.baseUrlCaptionOther: e.g. http://localhost:11434 for local Ollama, or any OpenAI-compatible endpoint.
configureAIProviders.secretCaption: Write-only. Leave empty for a local, unauthenticated endpoint (e.g. Ollama).
configureAIProviders.emptyDescription: A reusable connection to local Ollama, or a BYO OpenAI-compatible or Anthropic endpoint, that an AI workflow step resolves by ID.

configureStepTypes.heading: Step types
configureStepTypes.pageDescription: Create your own step types from things you've already configured: no code, just a name and a binding.
configureStepTypes.label: Label
configureStepTypes.engineCaption: What this step actually calls when it runs.
configureStepTypes.needsCodeExplanation: This needs code, not a declared step type. A declared step type can only name and configure something already connected: a request, an MCP server, or another workflow. Build a new step in code, then it becomes available to declare here too.
configureStepTypes.mcpToolFallbackCaption: Type the exact tool name; the server's tool list couldn't be reached.
configureStepTypes.pinnedFieldsDescription: Pin a value to lock it and hide it from anyone using this step. Leave a field unpinned to let them fill it in.
configureStepTypes.noPinnableFields: Nothing to pin for this binding.
configureStepTypes.emptyDescription: A named palette step assembled from a request, an MCP tool, or another workflow you've already configured.

entityRefField.noCallableWorkflowsHint: No callable workflows yet. Give a workflow a "callable by another workflow" trigger, then pick it here.
entityRefField.label: Label
entityRefField.categoryCaption: Fixed once created; duplicate this Decision to use a different category.
entityRefField.baseUrlCaptionAnthropic: Leave empty to use the real Anthropic API.

manualSchemaEditor.methodTooltip: The request's own Method (set at the top of this form).
manualSchemaEditor.inputDescription: The attributes this request accepts: parameters (path, query, or header) first, then the request body.
manualSchemaEditor.outputDescription: The attributes this request's response provides, for a workflow step to read and bind into its own Attributes.
manualSchemaEditor.secretCaption: A secret output can never be mapped into a workflow Attribute.
manualSchemaEditor.aliasCaption: Optional friendlier name shown in binding editors instead of the wire name.
manualSchemaEditor.extractPathCaption: Optional dot-path into nested response JSON, e.g. data.name.
manualSchemaEditor.allowedValuesCaption: Optional, comma-separated list of allowed values (an enum).

requestTestPanel.mustBeJsonObject: Must be a JSON object, e.g. {"id": "123"}.
requestTestPanel.noOperationsYet: The Schema tab doesn't declare any operations yet.

configureRequests.restApiRequestDescription: Call an external HTTP API: typed request/response schema, auth, headers.
configureRequests.heading: Integrations
configureRequests.emptyDescription: Call an external HTTP API with a typed request/response schema, auth, and headers.

requestAuthSections.notYetImplementedDescription: This auth type isn't built yet. A workflow run through this request fails with a clear error instead of a guessed signature. You can select it now and configure the request ahead of time.
requestAuthSections.scopeCaption: Leave blank to request no specific scope.
requestAuthSections.signatureHeaderCaption: Defaults to X-Signature when left blank.
requestAuthSections.leaveBlankToKeepSecret: Leave blank to keep the existing secret.
requestAuthSections.tokenSecretCaption: Omit for 2-legged OAuth 1.0a, same as Token above.

requestForm.label: Label
requestForm.urlCaption: The complete URL this integration calls, path included. Use {{brace}}param{{closeBrace}} templates, bound via the Schema's path parameters.
requestForm.descriptionCaption: Optional: what this request is for, or any caveat worth noting.
requestForm.headersDescription: Static headers (e.g. a required API version) sent with every call, in addition to whatever the Auth type adds.
requestForm.schemaDescription: The payload's structure only: typed input/output fields a workflow step can bind Attributes to. Method and URL live above and are never part of the schema. Leave empty to keep using a literal request body.
requestForm.multiOperationNote: This request's stored schema declares {{count}} operations, but a request is one call. Remove the extras below, or duplicate the request once per operation.
requestForm.fallbackBodyCaption: Sent as-is when the schema declares no body fields.
requestForm.joseDescription: Encrypts what Mill sends to this integration and, if you choose, decrypts what comes back.
requestForm.recipientPublicKeyCaption: The vendor's RSA public key. Not a secret.
requestForm.decryptResponseLabel: Decrypt response (this request's replies are also JWE-encrypted)
requestForm.leaveBlankToKeepKey: Leave blank to keep the existing key.

openapiSynth.notValidJsonSwitchBack: Not valid JSON. Switch back to "Paste OpenAPI" to edit as YAML, or fix the JSON first.

schemaIntake.nothingToLoad: Nothing to load. Paste content or drop a file first.
schemaIntake.noOperationsDeclared: The OpenAPI document declares no operations.
schemaIntake.unrecognizedFormat: Couldn't recognize this as OpenAPI JSON, a JSON sample, or CSV{{detail}}. CSV needs a header row: path,method,direction,name,in,type,required,secret,alias,extractPath.
schemaIntake.inferredFieldsNotice: Inferred {{count}} field{{plural}} from the JSON sample. Review below.
schemaIntake.textareaPlaceholder: Paste an OpenAPI document, a JSON sample payload, or CSV field rows here, or drop a .json/.csv file.

pasteSample.pasteJsonObject: Paste a JSON object (e.g. {"name": "..."}), not an array or a bare value.
pasteSample.noFieldsFound: No fields found in the pasted sample.

configureView.subtitle: Reusable connections, lists, and values that workflows reference. Defined once, used anywhere.

configureConversionProfiles.heading: Conversion profiles
configureConversionProfiles.label: Label
configureConversionProfiles.emptyDescription: A profile chooses which source-specific rules an HTML to Markdown conversion applies.
configureConversionProfiles.sampleCaption: Paste HTML you copied from a page or a document and compare what each profile makes of it.

configureSecretSources.heading: Secret sources
configureSecretSources.label: Label
configureSecretSources.pathCaptionOnePassword: Lists your 1Password items by title through the op tool; a vault name narrows it. Values are read one at a time when a step runs.
configureSecretSources.pathCaptionBitwarden: Lists your Bitwarden items by name through the bw tool, using the session of the shell that started Mill. Values are read one at a time when a step runs.
configureSecretSources.pathCaptionBruno: The collection folder (or its bruno.json): its .env supplies values, and every secret its environments declare is listed by name.
configureSecretSources.pathCaption: Keys in this file appear as secrets in every picker; values are read when a step runs and never copied.
configureSecretSources.emptyDescription: Point Mill at a .env file you already keep (a project's, or a Bruno collection's) and its keys become secrets you can reference.
